    Frequently asked questions

    Discover how NiyoGen is bringing intelligent AI agents to real-world applications.

    NiyoGen agents are purpose-built for high-stakes, real-world decisions. Unlike generic chatbots, they are context-aware, reason through complex trade-offs (EvolSpace), and operate within strict safety guardrails. They move from "answering questions" to "taking informed action."

    Security is our core foundation. Every agent built with FastGraph follows enterprise-grade PII controls and strict data isolation. We ensure that your proprietary information is used only to empower your agents, never to train global models.

    The best way is to request a free demo. Our team will walk you through potential architectures and how NiyoGen can be tailored to your specific industry needs.

    Yes, NiyoGen's architecture supports real-time multi-modal interactions, including high-fidelity voice. Many of our agents, like Tour Guardian, are designed specifically as real-time voice companions for on-the-go decision support.
